about_the_game:
🎮 Clawsome – Demo

Welcome to a bite-sized preview of Clawsome!
In this cozy claw machine adventure, you’ll get a taste of the whimsical world we’re building—one prize at a time.

This limited demo features the core grabbing mechanics, a selection of quirky figurines, and your very first diorama to decorate. Expect moving platforms, disappearing prizes, and a few surprises that make each grab a tiny challenge.

🧸 What’s in the demo?

  • The signature claw machine gameplay

  • Unique, animated prizes to collect

  • A peek at the diorama system

  • A relaxing, charming atmosphere

It’s just the beginning! The full game will feature even more figurines, mini-games, and secrets to uncover. Thanks for playing and joining Clawby on this first step of the journey!
